arxiv-2104-02892.title: Theory of the Kitaev model in a [111] magnetic field
arxiv-2104-02892.creator: Shang-Shun Zhang, Gábor B. Halász, Cristian D. Batista
arxiv-2104-02892.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shang-Shun Zhang, Gábor B. Halász, Cristian D. Batista. Recent numerical studies indicate that the antiferromagnetic Kitaev honeycomb lattice model undergoes a magnetic-field-induced quantum phase transition into a new spin-liquid phase. This intermediate-field phase has been previously characterized as a gapless spin liquid. By implementing a recently developed variational approach based on the exact fractionalized excitations of the zero-field model, we demonstrate that the field-induced spin liquid is gapped and belongs to Kitaev’s 16-fold way.

arxiv-2105-01971.title: Information theory and Electron Spin Resonance dating
arxiv-2105-01971.creator: C. Tannous, J. Gieraltowski
arxiv-2105-01971.description: Abstract Chronometric dating is becoming increasingly important in areas such as the Origin and evolution of Life on Earth and other planets, Origin and evolution of the Earth and the Solar System… Electron Spin Resonance (ESR) dating is based on exploiting effects of contamination by chemicals or ionizing radiation, on ancient matter through its absorption spectrum and lineshape.

arxiv-2111-00694.title: Localized-delocalized crossover of spin-carriers and magnetization reversal in Co 2 VO 4
arxiv-2111-00694.creator: Abhijit Bhat Kademane, Churna Bhandari, Durga Paudyal, Stephen Cottrell, Pinaki Das, Yong Liu, Yuen Yiu, C. M. Naveen Kumar, Konrad Siemensmeyer, Andreas Hoser, Diana Lucia Quintero-Castro, David Vaknin, Rasmus Toft-Petersen
arxiv-2111-00694.description: Abstract Neutron diffraction, magnetization and muon spin relaxation measurements, supplemented by density functional theory (DFT) calculations are employed to unravel temperature-driven magnetization reversal (MR) in inverse spinel Co 2 VO 4 . All measurements show a second order magnetic phase transition at T C = 168 T_{\rm C}=168 K to a collinear ferrimagnetic phase.

arxiv-2201-00157.title: Contact surgery numbers
arxiv-2201-00157.creator: John Etnyre, Marc Kegel, Sinem Onaran
arxiv-2201-00157.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by John Etnyre, Marc Kegel, Sinem Onaran. It is known that any contact 3 3 -manifold can be obtained by rational contact Dehn surgery along a Legendrian link L L in the standard tight contact 3 3 -sphere. We define and study various versions of contact surgery numbers, the minimal number of components of a surgery link L L describing a given contact 3 3 -manifold under consideration.

arxiv-2312-00220.title: Multi-Modal Video Topic Segmentation with Dual-Contrastive Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2312-00220.creator: Linzi Xing, Quan Tran, Fabian Caba, Franck Dernoncourt, Seunghyun Yoon, Zhaowen Wang, Trung Bui, Giuseppe Carenini
arxiv-2312-00220.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Linzi Xing, Quan Tran, Fabian Caba, Franck Dernoncourt, Seunghyun Yoon, Zhaowen Wang, Trung Bui, Giuseppe Carenini. Video topic segmentation unveils the coarse-grained semantic structure underlying videos and is essential for other video understanding tasks. Given the recent surge in multi-modal, relying solely on a single modality is arguably insufficient. On the other hand, prior solutions for similar tasks like video scene/shot segmentation cater to short videos with clear visual shifts but falter for long videos with subtle changes, such as livestreams.

arxiv-2406-04417.title: Asymptotically Schwarzschild solutions in f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) extension of general relativity
arxiv-2406-04417.creator: Federico Scali, Oliver F. Piattella
arxiv-2406-04417.description: Abstract We address the question of how to build a class of f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) extensions of general relativity which are compatible with solar system experiments, without making any preliminary assumption on the properties of f f .

arxiv-2406-09696.title: MoME: Mixture of Multimodal Experts for Cancer Survival Prediction
arxiv-2406-09696.creator: Conghao Xiong, Hao Chen, Hao Zheng ⋆, Dong Wei, Yefeng Zheng, Joseph J. Y. Sung, Irwin King
arxiv-2406-09696.description: Abstract Survival analysis, as a challenging task, requires integrating Whole Slide Images (WSIs) and genomic data for comprehensive decision-making. There are two main challenges in this task: significant heterogeneity and complex inter- and intra-modal interactions between the two modalities. Previous approaches utilize co-attention methods, which fuse features from both modalities only once after separate encoding.

arxiv-2409-08524.title: Quantum Metrology via Floquet-Engineered Two-axis Twisting and Turn Dynamics
arxiv-2409-08524.creator: Jihao Ma, Yi Shen, Jiahao Huang, Chaohong Lee
arxiv-2409-08524.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jihao Ma, Yi Shen, Jiahao Huang, Chaohong Lee. One core of quantum metrology is the utilization of entanglement to enhance measurement precision beyond the standard quantum limit. Here, we utilize the Floquet-engineered two-axis twisting (TAT) and turn dynamics to generate GHZ-like states for quantum metrology.

pmc-10669423.title: Are Plant–Soil Feedbacks Caused by Many Weak Microbial Interactions?
pmc-10669423.creator: Julia K. Aaronson, Andrew Kulmatiski, Leslie E. Forero, Josephine Grenzer, Jeanette M. Norton
pmc-10669423.description: Simple SummarySoil organism communities are typically different under different plant species. Often, soil bacteria and fungi that feed on a plant species will accumulate and decrease the growth of the dominant species. This effect has long been recognized in agricultural systems and more recently in more diverse and natural systems.

pmc-11465770.title: Incidence of Maxillary Sinus Disorders in Dental Patients Undergoing Cone-Beam Computed Tomography: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11465770.creator: Sawsan Saidahmed, Sarra Ali, Meaad Elbashir, Bashair Abu Habiba, Hana Mohammed, Belqees Hakami, Sarra Kamal, Asma Alamin, Esam S Alshameri, Ali Abdelrazig, Awadia Gareeballah
pmc-11465770.description: BackgroundCone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) was quickly adopted in dentistry settings due to its compact size, low cost, and minimal ionizing radiation dose when compared to medical computed tomography. CBCT generates three-dimensional (3D) images that are useful in a variety of oral and maxillofacial circumstances, including diagnosis and assessment of disease severity, treatment planning and delivery, and follow-up.

pmc-11524950.title: Analysis of the evolution of placental oxidative stress research from a bibliometric perspective
pmc-11524950.creator: Ailing Chen, Mengyuan Tian, Zouqing Luo, Xiaohui Cao, Yanfang Gu
pmc-11524950.description: BackgroundResearch on placental oxidative stress is pivotal for comprehending pregnancy-related physiological changes and disease mechanisms. Despite recent advancements, a comprehensive review of current status, hotspots, and trends remains challenging. This bibliometric study systematically analyzes the evolution of placental oxidative stress research, offering a reference for future studies.

pmc-12358336.title: Group-based phylogenetic models on 3-sunlet networks
pmc-12358336.creator: Shelby Cox, Elizabeth Gross, Samuel Martin
pmc-12358336.description: Phylogenetic networks describe the evolution of a set of taxa for which reticulate events have occurred at some point in their evolutionary history. Of particular interest is when the evolutionary history between a set of just three taxa has a reticulate event.

pmc-12665308.title: The influence of different proportions of rumen degradable protein and non-fiber carbohydrate consisted in feed ration on in vitro rumen fermentation, digestibility, gas production kinetics and enteric methane emission
pmc-12665308.creator: Ujang Hidayat Tanuwiria, Mardiati Zain, Jasmal Ahmari Syamsu, Yunilas Yunilas, Andi Mushawwir, Yulianri Rizki Yanza
pmc-12665308.description: Objective:The present study aimed to determine the influence of different rumen degradable protein (RDP)/non-fibrous carbohydrate (NFC) proportions on ruminal fermentation characteristics, gas production kinetics, and microbial populations.Materials and Methods:An in vitro batch culture trial was conducted using different combinations of RDP/NFC proportions categorized into six dietary treatments (n = 5 per treatment, three replicative runs).

pmc-12962292.title: Biochemical characterization of xyloglucan galactosyltransferases MUR3 and XLT2 from Spirodela polyrhiza
pmc-12962292.creator: Charles J Corulli, Alexander S Graf, Digantkumar Chapla, Liang Zhang, Samantha J Ziegler, James Byrnes, Yannick J Bomble, Kelley W Moremen, Breeanna R Urbanowicz, Pradeep K Prabhakar
pmc-12962292.description: SUMMARYGlycosyltransferases (GTs) are the primary enzymes responsible for the biosynthesis of the complex polysaccharides in plant cell walls. Given the important role of GTs in plants, it is necessary to undertake their functional characterization to better understand plant cell wall synthesis pathways to develop improved feedstocks for efficient conversion into fuels and products to support the emerging bioeconomy.

pmc-13257890.title: Heparanase‐Loaded CAR T Extracellular Vesicles Remodel the Colorectal Tumour Microenvironment and Boost T Cell Antitumor Immunity
pmc-13257890.creator: Songshan Zhu, Jun Yin, Weiqiang Yang, Xin Fu, Yiwei Zeng, Na Huang, Ling Zhang, Cong Yu, Ping Ouyang, Kaisong Huang, Rui Chen, Xiaolei Zhao, Dan Jiang, Guangxian Xu
pmc-13257890.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy has shown promise in solid tumours, but its efficacy is limited by dense extracellular matrix (ECM) that blocks T cell entry. We engineered mesothelin‐targeted CAR T cells to express heparanase (HPSE) fused to the truncated hepatitis A virus pX domain (pX‐Δ1‐30), enabling surface display of HPSE on extracellular vesicles for localized, pH‐dependent ECM degradation within the acidic tumour microenvironment while limiting systemic exposure.

pmc-13402960.creator: Narges Sadat Soltani, Farahnaz Heshmat, Mohadese Bakhshi Ghalibaf, Malihe Mahmoudinia, Robab Latifnejad Roudsari
pmc-13402960.description: BackgroundSpirituality is currently a major focus of health care provision.
